channel.title: LemonKAI
channel.description: Kai Ning 的技術筆記：Kubernetes 主線、生產筆記與概念介紹。

item.title: KAI Road of Kubernetes 03 — What a Service is, and why Pod IPs should not be your interface
item.description: Pods can be replaced by Deployments at any time. A Service gives a changing group of Pods a stable network entry point through DNS, ClusterIP, selectors, EndpointSlices, and ready backend endpoints.

item.title: KAI K8s之路 03｜Service 是什麼？Pod 會換，入口不能飄
item.description: Pod 可以被 Deployment 不斷替換，但呼叫方不能每天追新的 Pod IP。Service 把一組可替換 Pod 包成穩定入口，讓流量能透過 DNS、ClusterIP、selector 和 EndpointSlice 找到真正 ready 的後端。

item.title: KAI Road of Kubernetes 02 — What a Deployment is, and why Pods should not be babysat manually
item.description: A Pod is not enough. A Deployment captures the desired replica count, Pod template, selector, and rollout behavior so Kubernetes can keep a workload converged.

item.title: KAI K8s之路 02｜Deployment 是什麼？為什麼 Pod 不該手動照顧
item.description: 有了 Pod 還不夠。Deployment 把「我想要幾個 Pod、用哪個版本、怎麼更新」寫成 desired state，讓 Kubernetes 持續把 workload 拉回正軌。

item.title: GitOps review checklist before Argo CD syncs production
item.description: A compact pre-sync checklist for GitOps changes so an innocent YAML edit does not become surprising production behavior in Kubernetes.

item.title: KAI Road of Kubernetes 01 — What a Kubernetes Pod is, and why it does not manage containers directly
item.description: Start with the core Kubernetes abstraction: what a Pod actually manages, and why Kubernetes schedules Pods instead of orchestrating containers directly.

item.title: Kubernetes 探針誤判：一次把服務打進重啟循環的 liveness probe 事故
item.description: 有些事故不是程式壞掉，而是 liveness probe 把本來還能活下來的服務誤判成該重啟。這篇記一個很典型的生產坑。

item.title: KAI K8s之路 01｜Pod 是什麼？為什麼 Kubernetes 不直接管理 container
item.description: 從 Kubernetes 最核心的抽象開始：Pod 到底在管什麼，為什麼平台不是直接管理單個 container，而是用 Pod 當最小調度單位。

item.title: Kubernetes deployment guardrails: probes, rollout settings, and fast triage
item.description: A compact baseline for readiness, liveness, rollout settings, and fast triage before a Kubernetes deployment turns into an outage.

item.title: Agent observability in production: spans, tool events, and failure memory
item.description: Basic logging is not enough for agent systems in production; you need traces, tool-level outcomes, and a short path from failure back to prompt or policy.
